findings.description: The complete shipped Stata reproduction was not executed; Stata is unavailable, and only the Figure 2 transformations were translated and run.
findings.evidence: The package requires Stata 16.1; no Stata executable is present. The shipped data preparation and analysis scripts total 2,610 lines across three do-files. The translated R code covers the Figure 2 calculations only.

limitations: The complete article PDF could not be retrieved from the publisher in this environment; publisher PDF access returned HTTP 403. The article abstract and package README were accessible.
The package includes the full Stata source and original input data, but no generated analysis dataset. Stata 16.1 is unavailable.
Only the Figure 2 cumulative-sharing calculations were directly translated and run. No result is reported as if the unexecuted full analysis had reproduced it.
Original code and data remain in their supplied package location and were not copied into this certification directory.
